records.source: The Chalky Biscuit cracked way above the Planet
records.translation: Nabiyak ang Mala-tisang Biskwit sa malayong ibabaw ng Planeta

records.source: The Green Pepper grilled alongside the Cheese
records.translation: Inihaw ang Berdeng Sili katabi ng Keso

records.source: The Chunky Raincoat smelled dangerously close to the Shoe
records.translation: Mapanganib na umamoy ang Makapal na Kapote nang napakalapit sa Sapatos

records.source: The Gigantic Submarine floated uncomfortably close to the Mermaid
records.translation: Lumutang ang Napakalaking Submarino nang hindi komportableng malapit sa Sirena

records.source: The Greasy Hyena stood too close to the other Hyena
records.translation: Tumayo ang Mamantikang Hyena nang napakalapit sa isa pang Hyena

records.source: The Gloomy Elf danced atop the Tomb
records.translation: Sumayaw ang Malungkot na Duwende sa ibabaw ng Libingan

records.source: The Crusty Lip cracked way above the Biscuit
records.translation: Nabiyak ang Magaspang na Labi sa malayong ibabaw ng Biskwit

records.source: The Rubbery Elf swam near the Disaster
records.translation: Lumangoy ang Gomang Duwende malapit sa Sakuna

records.source: The Courageous Quail grilled far, far away from the other Quail
records.translation: Inihaw ang Matapang na Pugo nang napakalayo sa isa pang Pugo

records.source: The Reasonable Hyena spoke with the Shoe
records.translation: Nakipag-usap ang Makatwirang Hyena sa Sapatos

records.source: The Practical Submarine cracked miles below the Mermaid
records.translation: Nabiyak ang Praktikal na Submarino nang ilang milya sa ilalim ng Sirena

records.source: The Lonely Puppet ran far, far away from the Planet
records.translation: Tumakbo ang Malungkot na Papet nang napakalayo sa Planeta
